svg.title: Pruning-point move: per-node update timeline and phases
svg.desc: Two panels. a) Fifth of five consecutive pruning-point moves, seconds relative to the start of node C's update. C updates from 0 to 125 s (restore 5 s, commitment scan 117 s, deletion and commit 1.6 s). Nodes A and B process no blocks from -4 s until the moving block arrives at +107.9 s and +108.1 s, then update for 243 s and 207 s, ending at +351 s and +315 s. b) Update phases: C no cap 125 s; A no cap 243 s (restore 25, scan 215); A with a 7 GiB cap 380 s (restore 115, scan 236, deletion and commit 26); B no cap 207 s (restore 45, scan 160); B with the cap 317 s (restore 83, scan 172, deletion and commit 60).
